implemented_requirements.evidence: question.py defines Question with types "multiple_choice" and "short_answer" and displays choices; quiz.py calls question.display() for each question.

Quiz.run increments self.score when question.is_correct(user_answer) returns true and stores results in self.results.

main.py parses --bank argument, creates QuestionBank(args.bank), and loads the JSON file.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Option to display correct answers after the quiz
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py passes --show-answers flag to Quiz; Quiz.run calls review_answers() when show_answers_after is True, and also offers a prompt via _offer_review() if not.
